notes.title: The Coffee Boost
notes.content:
[h3]What is the Coffee Boost?[/h3][p]In the exploration segments of 1000 Deaths, you may have noticed the Coffee Cups that you can collect if you approach. What these cups do is give you a boost so that you can quickly run through exploration segments.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="rOTxWV9iPeM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The Coffee Cup Collectible can be found in several locations in the game, with the first one in Nowherestown. Use it to speedrun through exploration segments when you are doing a full game speedrun.
[/p][h3]How did we create it?[/h3][p]Interestingly, this collectible was not a feature we had planned on. During development, one of the developers realized that she had to run the same route hundreds of times to check the game. To speed things up, she added a sprint feature that made the characters run comically fast. We then decided to implement the “Coffee” pickup in the game, so that you can unlock this high-speed sprint we had initially used for development! 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/f330c0a2fdc74925b30d12190c85dbb502a791e1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/659dee3cb64167b73e0fc0cde61a3ac216e1467d.png"][/img]
[/p][p]Drink that coffee and start speedrunning![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Join the 1000 Deaths Community! notes.title: So, What’s the Story of 1000 Deaths All About?
notes.content:
While 1000 Deaths unfolds in three distinct episodes, its storylines aren't presented chronologically. Players experience the lives of our protagonists, Maxie, Boga, Terry, and Vayu, from different perspectives and across different ages. Each episode explores a core theme and focuses on specific character pairings.

[b]Firestorm: Friendship, Politics[/b]
Firestorm, the first episode developed, introduces Vayu and Maxie. Vayu, loyal to Maxie, struggles between supporting their friend's ambition for big-city fame and helping their hometown in need. This episode lays the foundation for the overarching narrative and introduces the platforming hubs known as Headspaces. Platforming mechanics fluctuate between puzzle-style levels involving entering doors at the correct gravity orientations and action-packed levels with Maxie-themed lava balls as your main enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/0070ffa3fb547b78235ca75fe4d7ac1934455d66.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/f8a35d3043d3e48211e5d825006169cca294c78e.jpg[/img]

[b]Offshoot: Labor, Ethics[/b]
Offshoot explores the bond between Terry and Boga as they navigate the complexities of growing up and pursuing careers. Terry views Boga as a follower and must confront their worldview while Boga struggles with different career paths. This episode features intricate platforming puzzles centered around toggle switches, reflecting Boga’s inability to make decisions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/7b845d8317d413f00b85fb27fea5d0f3a39023c4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/ac863dc863db8c39cc114330c8f2ad3b31c9e0a4.png[/img]

[b]Moonshine: Love, Trauma[/b]
Moonshine explores the complexities of love and the scars of trauma. It follows Maxie and Boga as they chase music stardom, a pursuit that threatens to tear their relationship apart. This emotionally charged episode delves into the consequences of repression and the impact of past experiences. The platforming uses gravity-switching triggers to evoke the rollercoaster-like feeling of heated romance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/25d1c7f0783fdba2d0b9a67fa93276835b592300.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/f9a7fc66222ef629a6f75550a62aa785b7c23c95.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Extra, Extra! Read all about our NPCs here!
notes.content:
Let’s talk about our NPCs! 1000 Deaths isn’t just about the mind-bending platforming or the branching narrative (yeah, we’ve been talking about that a lot). It's also about the characters you meet along the way. In this update, we'd like to show you the journey of our NPCs, from brainstorming to creating the final in-game models!

[b]Character Ideation & Development[/b]
For 1000 Deaths, we knew NPCs had to be more than scenery. We wanted them to tell stories silently through their designs, enrich the game's lore, and reinforce narrative points. Our brainstorming sessions were a riot! We envisioned everything from purple-suited giants with singular eyeballs, to fluffy sheep with a penchant for pastries. A walking fish tank appeared alongside a surprisingly realistic, tattooed Sphynx cat. Each "weird character" came with unique personalities and roles, breathing life into the world of 1000 Deaths. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/91d263618b381d277b717a4a8798b80a269af1c1.png[/img]

[b]Capturing Ideas through Concept Art[/b]
With a core cast of NPCs established, we assigned them to specific areas based on vibes: Nowherestown, Jollywood Outer, Jollywood City, the beach, and Levity Falls. Each location's aesthetic heavily influenced the NPCs' art styles, ensuring a seamless blend within the world of 1000 Deaths. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/875c1f687a56c8804583451119e06cb99210c2e2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/7cb4f726ed0c51b269e649fb95f3d410e067ee03.png[/img]

[b]Modeling, From Sketch to 3D[/b]
With the concept art locked down, our 3D team built out each NPC model. We added textures and accessories and experimented with different animations and voiceovers to deliver convincing dialogues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/e331c5f80da28fee8a761c5a7494aa3b9261e45f.gif[/img]

[b]The Final Touch[/b]
Then came the hardest part: figuring out which NPC went where and what they said to each of our main characters. We considered level design, story progression, and gameplay flow, as some characters were developed with certain locations in mind. NPC dialogues were similarly crafted to add to the narrative and character personalities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/8b83e735f3963a15307aa21a5028801192d45286.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/3e3696cba97ee2d39c94f038e1d922a1fe4e3488.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/66ca59369391f79173adc2e45b4ff104cb059171.gif[/img]

We can't wait for you to meet them all when the game launches!

notes.title: From Vision to Reality: How We Crafted the World of 1000 Deaths
notes.content:
We're thrilled to introduce 1000 Deaths, a vibrant game where your choices shape your destiny and levels defy your perception.

In development since 2020, 1000 Deaths has transformed from a humble prototype into a sprawling adventure. Explore a branching story with unique challenges! In 1000 Deaths, you'll explore a branching story and conquer short, intense levels in mini-hubs. Each mini-hub unlocks after a key decision, propelling you forward in time to see how your choices impact the story. You'll experience different gameplay mechanics along the way, keeping things fresh and exciting!

Explore multiple episodes with branching narratives, traverse dozens of tightly-designed platforming arcade levels, and make choices that completely change the story. Imagine a world where classic cartoon aesthetics meet innovative gameplay. That's the experience we're crafting in 1000 Deaths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/114fb13cb9780697c7fb4a30b9e721b0b0583e5a.gif[/img]

1000 Deaths isn't just about platforming prowess; it's mastering the unexpected. Here's a taste of the key mechanics that will keep you on your toes:

[list]
[*] [b]Branching Narrative:[/b] Every decision you make alters the course of the story, leading to unique consequences and replayable experiences. 
[*] [b]Mind-Bending Levels:[/b] Prepare for gravity-defying challenges, warped perspectives, and levels that twist and turn.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/007077db5436a8e212853b3becb3957b0fc4e298.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Power Up:[/b] Unlock jetpacks to soar and dodge flying lava balls, use switches to manipulate platforms and change your gravity. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/b7fa944b3a2445c45838e9b79e5cb07ee6d24d78.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Spunky Art:[/b] 1000 Deaths is a love letter to classic cartoons with a modern twist. The vibrant visuals and quirky characters mask a surprisingly deep and challenging gameplay experience.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/63d7a439fac37fe6e215137dac44ce9edacdaad1.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]For the Speedrunners:[/b] Love a good challenge? Our meticulously crafted levels offer multiple paths and hidden shortcuts, ideal for mastering your skills and competing for the fastest times. 
[/list]

Whether you're a seasoned platformer veteran or a newcomer seeking a delightful adventure, 1000 Deaths offers a captivating experience. Stay tuned for further updates where we'll delve deeper into the world, story, and the lovable cast of characters waiting to meet you in 1000 Deaths!

Gear up for the adventure! Wishlist, subscribe, and follow us for all the wacky updates!
